tha-ap449:1.1: Sīhāsanika.] Padumuttarassa bhagavato sabbabhūtahitesino / pasannacitto sumano sīhāsanam adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap449:2.1: Devaloke manusse vā yattha yattha vasām' ahaṃ / labhāmi vipulaṃ vyamhaṃ sīhāsanass' idaṃ phalaṃ // //
tha-ap449:3.1: Sovaṇṇamayā rūpimayā lohitaṅkamayā bahū / maṇimayā ca pallaṅkā nibbattanti mamaṃ sadā. // //
tha-ap449:4.1: Bodhiyā āsanaṃ katvā jalajuttamanāmino / ucce kule pajāyāmi aho dhammasudhammatā. // //
tha-ap449:5.1: Satasahasse ito kappe sīhāsanam akās' ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi sīhāsanass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap449:9.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sīhāsaniko thero i. g. a-ti.
